releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.10.8 - Multi-WAN Uplinks + Password-Proof Cloud + Live Portal
releaseNotes:
• 🌐 MULTI-WAN UPLINKS (new tab, appears on Dual/Triple WAN routers): deploy Load Balancing (PCC bandwidth weights, e.g. 2:1) or Failover Priority in one tap — per-uplink routing tables + check-gateway + NAT + automatic failover, live per-uplink ↓↑ traffic, one-tap cleanup. 100% app-side, no VPS.
• 🛡 PASSWORD-CHANGE-PROOF CLOUD: routers get a VPS-only cloud service account locked to the WireGuard tunnel — customers can change their own router password freely and cloud enforcement NEVER breaks; the app pushes changed passwords to the cloud automatically.
• 📋 CUSTOMER-PLAN TRUTH: voucher activation + the cloud enforcer resolve quota/validity from the ACTUAL voucher/profile values first — customer-created plans with any name are cut exactly as configured.
• 🔄 PLAN PROPAGATION: profile edits (quota/speeds/validity/price) apply IMMEDIATELY to ALL active + unused vouchers — remaining = new plan − used, instant cut-off, deadline = activation + new validity.
• 📡 LIVE PORTAL DATA: the captive portal shows the router's real SSID as the brand + 🔥 Hot Plans price cards built from the actual profiles (plans.js written by the app — no VPS).
• 🔍 EASY ONBOARDING: auto-Find Router (Wi-Fi gateway detection) + factory-password fallback; profile speeds always display the configured plan.
• 🎫 Voucher card fixes: remaining-quota chip no longer squeezed into '…', human GB units ('40 GB'), unambiguous '29d 0h 30m' remaining time, unused vouchers show their full quota.
